item.title: Murph notices meaningful new routines
item.summary: In its weekly health check, Murph can now notice a repeated new behavior tied to something you said matters and send one useful, natural continuation.
item.details: A single event, routine shortfall, duplicate note, or poorly timed interruption stays quiet. Without a current intention from you, Murph can only make a neutral observation and cannot create a goal, reminder, or accountability loop.
